candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order /v1/orders fails with HTTP 500, so the order service is the origin of the failure.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics are absent; the specific internal fault in order (db, payment, inventory) is not established.

report.explanation: Every checkout 502 correlates with a gateway client call to order returning 500 in logs and traces; gateway health endpoints stay 200, so the failure originates downstream at order. The exact order-internal fault is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and traces for /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
